```{r data}
curve_files <- list(
  usa = "usa-bs.csv",
  gbr = "gbr-bs.csv",
  jpn = "jpn-bs.csv",
  cad = "cad-bs.csv",
  ger = "ger-bs.csv"
)

curves <- names(curve_files)
mats <- c(1, 3, 6, 12, 24, 60, 84, 120, 240, 360)

start_date <- as.Date("2010-01-01")
end_date <- as.Date("2020-12-31")
lambdas <- seq(0.01, 0.15, by = 0.005)
cutoffs <- c(4, 8)

yields <- lapply(curve_files, function(file_name) {
  read.csv(here::here("reconstructed_data", file_name), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
})

yields <- lapply(yields, function(curve_df) {
  curve_df |>
    dplyr::filter(
      as.Date(time) >= start_date,
      as.Date(time) <= end_date
    )
})

## truncated yields: window only 
years <- 2010:2020

annual_yields <- setNames(lapply(years, function(year) {
  lapply(yields, function(curve_df) {
    curve_df %>%
      dplyr::filter(format(as.Date(time), "%Y") == as.character(year))
  })
}), years)
```

```{r helpers}
build_curve_panel <- function(yield_list, curves) {
  out <- data.frame(time = as.Date(yield_list[[1]]$time))

  for (curve_name in curves) {
    curve_df <- yield_list[[curve_name]][, -1, drop = FALSE]
    colnames(curve_df) <- paste0(curve_name, ".", sub("^X", "", colnames(curve_df)))
    out <- cbind(out, curve_df)
  }

  out
}

fit_annual_dly_models <- function(annual_yields, mats, lambdas, curves, reference,
                                  seed = NULL, center = TRUE, scale. = FALSE) {
  if (!is.null(seed)) {
    set.seed(seed)
  }

  setNames(lapply(annual_yields, function(yield_window) {
    dly_fit(
      yields = yield_window,
      mats = mats,
      lambdas = lambdas,
      curves = curves,
      reference = reference,
      center = center,
      scale. = scale.
    )
  }), names(annual_yields))
}

extract_annual_dns_estimates <- function(annual_dly_fits, curves) {
  setNames(lapply(annual_dly_fits, function(fit_obj) {
    setNames(lapply(curves, function(curve_name) {
      dns_fit <- fit_obj$single_curve[[curve_name]]
      dns_df <- data.frame(dns_fit$time, as.data.frame(dns_fit$nsfit$NSfit))
      colnames(dns_df) <- c("time", dns_fit$yield_names)
      dns_df
    }), curves)
  }), names(annual_dly_fits))
}

extract_annual_dly_estimates <- function(annual_dly_fits, curves,
                                         component = c("raw", "global", "idiosyncratic")) {
  component <- match.arg(component)

  setNames(lapply(annual_dly_fits, function(fit_obj) {
    fit_obj$yields[[component]][curves]
  }), names(annual_dly_fits))
}

build_error_matrix <- function(actual_panel, fitted_panel) {
  actual_panel <- actual_panel %>%
    dplyr::mutate(time = as.Date(time)) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(time)

  fitted_panel <- fitted_panel %>%
    dplyr::mutate(time = as.Date(time)) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(time)

  common_time <- intersect(actual_panel$time, fitted_panel$time)

  actual_panel <- actual_panel[match(common_time, actual_panel$time), , drop = FALSE]
  fitted_panel <- fitted_panel[match(common_time, fitted_panel$time), , drop = FALSE]

  common_cols <- setdiff(intersect(colnames(actual_panel), colnames(fitted_panel)), "time")
  error_mat <- as.matrix(actual_panel[, common_cols, drop = FALSE] -
    fitted_panel[, common_cols, drop = FALSE])
  colnames(error_mat) <- common_cols
  error_mat
}

bind_annual_errors <- function(actual_annual_panels, fitted_annual_panels) {
  purrr::imap_dfr(actual_annual_panels, function(actual_panel, year_label) {
    error_mat <- build_error_matrix(actual_panel, fitted_annual_panels[[year_label]])
    tibble::as_tibble(error_mat) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        year = as.integer(year_label),
        .before = 1
      )
  })
}

error_summary <- function(error_df, model_name) {
  error_mat <- as.matrix(error_df[, setdiff(colnames(error_df), "year"), drop = FALSE])

  error_long <- tibble::as_tibble(error_mat) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(
      cols = dplyr::everything(),
      names_to = "series",
      values_to = "error"
    ) %>%
    tidyr::separate(series, into = c("curve", "maturity"), sep = "\\.", remove = FALSE)

  list(
    overall = tibble::tibble(
      model = model_name,
      rmse = sqrt(mean(error_mat^2, na.rm = TRUE)),
      mae = mean(abs(error_mat), na.rm = TRUE)
    ),
    by_curve = error_long |>
      dplyr::group_by(curve) |>
      dplyr::summarise(
        model = model_name,
        rmse = sqrt(mean(error^2, na.rm = TRUE)),
        mae = mean(abs(error), na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
      ),
    by_maturity = error_long |>
      dplyr::group_by(maturity) |>
      dplyr::summarise(
        model = model_name,
        rmse = sqrt(mean(error^2, na.rm = TRUE)),
        mae = mean(abs(error), na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
      )
  )
}
```

```{r fit-models}
fit_seed <- 999

annual_actual_panels <- setNames(lapply(annual_yields, build_curve_panel, curves = curves), names(annual_yields))

dly_annual_fits <- fit_annual_dly_models(
  annual_yields = annual_yields,
  mats = mats,
  lambdas = lambdas,
  curves = curves,
  reference = "usa",
  seed = fit_seed
)

annual_dns_estimates <- extract_annual_dns_estimates(dly_annual_fits, curves)
annual_dly_raw_estimates <- extract_annual_dly_estimates(dly_annual_fits, curves, component = "raw")
annual_dly_global_estimates <- extract_annual_dly_estimates(dly_annual_fits, curves, component = "global")
annual_dly_idio_estimates <- extract_annual_dly_estimates(dly_annual_fits, curves, component = "idiosyncratic")

dly_in <- dly_annual_fits[["2010"]]
```

```{r dly-sanity}
dly_raw_panel <- build_curve_panel(annual_dly_raw_estimates[["2010"]], curves)
dly_global_panel <- build_curve_panel(annual_dly_global_estimates[["2010"]], curves)
dly_idio_panel <- build_curve_panel(annual_dly_idio_estimates[["2010"]], curves)
```

```{r dly-factor-summary}
dly_lambda_table <- purrr::imap_dfr(dly_annual_fits, function(fit_obj, year_label) {
  tibble::tibble(
    year = as.integer(year_label),
    curve = names(fit_obj$lambdas),
    lambda = unname(fit_obj$lambdas),
    level_loading = unname(fit_obj$factor_models$level$loading[names(fit_obj$lambdas)]),
    level_rsq = unname(fit_obj$factor_models$level$r_squared[names(fit_obj$lambdas)]),
    slope_loading = unname(fit_obj$factor_models$slope$loading[names(fit_obj$lambdas)]),
    slope_rsq = unname(fit_obj$factor_models$slope$r_squared[names(fit_obj$lambdas)])
  )
})

dly_lambda_table
```

```{r in-sample-metrics}
dly_raw_errors <- bind_annual_errors(annual_actual_panels, lapply(annual_dly_raw_estimates, build_curve_panel, curves = curves))
dly_global_errors <- bind_annual_errors(annual_actual_panels, lapply(annual_dly_global_estimates, build_curve_panel, curves = curves))

dly_raw_metrics <- error_summary(dly_raw_errors, "dly_raw")
dly_global_metrics <- error_summary(dly_global_errors, "dly_global")

overall_metrics <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  dly_raw_metrics$overall,
  dly_global_metrics$overall
)

curve_metrics <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  dly_raw_metrics$by_curve,
  dly_global_metrics$by_curve
)

maturity_metrics <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  dly_raw_metrics$by_maturity,
  dly_global_metrics$by_maturity
)

curve_metric_table <- curve_metrics %>%
  dplyr::select(model, curve, rmse, mae) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = model,
    values_from = c(rmse, mae),
    names_glue = "{model}_{.value}"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(curve)

curve_metric_table
```

```{r overall-plot}
ggplot2::ggplot(overall_metrics, ggplot2::aes(x = model, y = rmse, fill = model)) +
  ggplot2::geom_col(width = 0.7) +
  ggplot2::theme_minimal() +
  ggplot2::theme(legend.position = "none") +
  ggplot2::labs(title = "Overall In-Sample RMSE", x = NULL, y = "RMSE")
```

  ggplot2::geom_line() +
  ggplot2::theme_minimal() +
  ggplot2::labs(title = "In-Sample RMSE by Curve", x = "Curve", y = "RMSE")
